analysis.name: Brian Rouleau
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 5 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment: If I could take his class every semester I would. Just pay attention to his lectures, take good notes, and do a mild review before every test and you will make an A. Professor Rouleau is the best lecturer I've ever had and his passion makes this class not only manageable, but almost easy! DO YOURSELF A FAVOR AND TAKE THIS CLASS!!!

I didn't take HIST 105, I took HIST 434: History of Film

Dr. Rouleau was an amazing professor, incredibly knowledgeable and passionate over the topic. I'm lucky enough to be taking him again before I graduate, and I would encourage you to take him if you can. He's very funny, what's expected of you is clearly laid out, and he wants you to succeed.

Just attend lectures and blindly take notes. What he speaks is what appears on the exam. Don't miss a single lecture no content posted online make note taking friends if missing. Questions are straight forward and easy. 40 out of 50 questions are just lecture content. 10 are from readings for which 2-3 youtube summaries is enough.

Amazing prof! I loved his class. It was almost like he was telling a story. Very engaging and passionate! Tests are fairly easy if you pay attention and take notes. Graded on 3 exams and one essay. He offers extra credit at the end. The final is not cumulative. If you show up to class, pay attention, and take notes you will do well.

Professor Rouleau is super passionate about what he teaches and makes lectures interesting. Be sure to attend class and take notes for the test. Only graded on tests and one essay. Super easy class if you take notes and put in effort!!

review_highlights.comment: Professor Morvant is a great professor. I have/had her for math 140 and while the subject is difficult she is amazing at teaching the problems step by step.

I had her for Math 140 and really enjoyed her class! There was one in-class quiz each week, which was usually pretty difficult. We also had two homework assignments due at the end of each week. She responds to emails quickly and is helpful during her office hours. No extra credit and she uses iClicker so attendance is important.

She is adorable! I had her for her first semester teaching a non-summer class and she was awesome. Her lectures were very helpful, and she responded to emails so quickly and gave great feedback. I would recommend her to anyone who is taking math 140!
She was awesome! One quiz each week (rotated between group and individual quizzes) weren't too hard as long as you understood the material. Exams are straightforward. I would highly reccomend!

He tells you what's going to be on the exams, and you get one exam cheat sheet (make sure your cheat sheets are good!) There is a generous curve so nearly everyone passes.

analysis.verdict: Mixed reviews. Student experiences vary quite a bit, but ratings have been improving recently
analysis.confidence_detail: Only 4 reviews so far, take these numbers with a grain of salt

review_highlights.comment: Dr McKinnon is very knowledgeable about the course material and has a genuine interest in teaching and engaging his students in linguistics. There are assignments for every class, but they aren't very time consuming. If you attend class and do the work, you will succeed. Super friendly professor and super fun class.

SPAN 350 was my number one favorite class here at A&M! We learned about each individual sound of the Spanish language, as well as the dialectal differences, and I had so much fun learning how to write phonetic transcriptions.  I've taken 3 classes w/ Dr. McKinnon, and he is super kind, friendly, and really cares about his students.  100% recommend!

Crazy workload for this course - you must participate and attend, there are frequent quizzes, daily homework, and 20 page take home exams that take hours. He is a kind prof that teaches interesting content well, but the amount of work is unreasonable and hard to manage. Don't recommend unless you genuinely want to learn linguistics.
